subject: sounds
title: Double letters and ck
about: Hear a word and pick the double-letter spelling that makes its last sound: ll, ss, ff, zz, dd, gg, tt or ck. CKLA Unit 1 lessons 23-24 teach that these two-letter spellings make one sound.
tip: Say: two letters, but you only hear one sound at the end.

cards.note: bell ends with ll. Two letters, one sound.
